environment.hardware: NVIDIA H200 143771 MiB, driver 580.173.02; run manifest reports JAX device cuda:0

mathematics.assertion_tested: For five frozen greedy PACK policies on all 32 natural validation starts, a fixed-success trajectory with k risky harvests has stochastic-overwrite success probability (1-p)^k and expected discounted return R_fixed*(1-p)^k; compare the resulting 160-start polynomial with the p-invariant zero-trigger reference and locate their panel-average return equality point on [0,1].
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Integer episode counts and risk counts; fixed path returns are binary64 values 0.995^(length-1); grouped polynomial coefficients, evaluation, and bisection use IEEE-754 binary64.
mathematics.conventions: p is the independent Bernoulli overwrite probability per physical transition, with a draw consumed on every step but a state change only at trigger B. Trigger B is a valid harvest with pre-harvest carried grain c>0. Any fire destroys exactly c grain. A failed episode has return zero. The aggregate is an equal-weight mean over 160 seed-start pairs, and the reference is a feasible scripted path rather than an optimality oracle.
inputs: /raid/ext_csv/HackRL/runs/pack_restore_scale_bc_v1/size_s/pack/dual/fixed seeds 30-34 checkpoint adapt_4096, with per-file hashes in the canonical run manifest
non_claims: The scripted zero-loss reference is not claimed to be globally optimal.
The finite-panel crossover is not claimed to generalize to unseen policies, starts, or correlated defects.
No PPO learning, adaptation-time damage estimate, or statistical-significance claim is part of this computation.
No bounded computation is presented as a universal theorem about overwrite-defect environments.

randomness.generator: No random sample enters the polynomial or crossover. Fixed JAX PRNGKey values are used only to verify same-key reproducibility and exact p=0/p=1 stochastic-kernel endpoints.

checks: Enumerated 73 states and all 24 actions for 1,752 transitions; forced false, forced true, p=0, p=1, independent-trigger-oracle, and same-key checks all had zero mismatches.
For every seed and the aggregate, formula values at p=0 and p=1 matched direct fixed and deterministic-overwrite rollouts within 1e-12 for success and discounted return.
All 32 reference paths replayed with success, zero trigger, zero loss, and exact equality to the pinned prior artifact.
All five preregistered seeds and all 32 starts were retained; source and checkpoint hashes were unchanged through completion.
The aggregate crossover was bracketed and bisected to interval [0.12177352054095536, 0.12177352054186485].
result: All no-learning gates passed. The aggregate existing-policy expected return is 0.25001797193519576 + 0.6588550292290284*(1-p), the reference expected return is 0.8286419047284275, and equality occurs at p=0.12177352054141011 within a 9.094947017729282e-13 interval. Training was not started.
residual_risks: Environment, evaluator, trigger oracle, reference, and analytic implementation are internally authored; endpoint and locality cross-checks reduce implementation risk but do not provide external validity.
Binary64 is sufficient for the reported 1e-12 bracket in this well-conditioned linear aggregate, but the v1 manifest records no independently rerun higher-precision calculation.
The five policies are related by a common training recipe, and 160 episodes are a finite deterministic panel rather than 160 independent learned-policy replications.
Only independent Bernoulli events are modeled; temporal correlation or state-dependent probabilities could change the regime boundary.
